plan.question: Does the observed dense K2 output discrepancy at C13,2 persist after zeroing unrelated operands and after relocating the same ordered products to C00?

estimands.primary: For each declared pattern and execution order, retain complete exact WMMA/scalar diagnostics and the nominated output word.
estimands.isolation: Compare dense-origin against isolated-origin, retaining identical ordered A-row13/B-column2 terms while setting unrelated operands to zero.
estimands.relocation: Compare isolated-origin C13,2 against isolated-c00 C0,0 using the same ordered pairs and exact reference.

plan.trace_selection: All three K2 patterns were selected before execution; each paired trace is WMMA-first.
plan.acceptance: Retain complete numerical failure with the exact oracle unchanged. Structural, input-snapshot or guard corruption stops subsequent stages. No performance acceptance or predetermined scalar/WMMA outcome.
limitations: These three controlled patterns do not establish a globally minimal counterexample or a unique arithmetic cause.
Three input snapshots establish capture-boundary equality only, not transient values inside a kernel.
Source-level scalar operations are not a forced ISA implementation; unchanged kernel bodies do not establish unchanged binaries.
Default, old scalar-control and prefix regressions remain auxiliary observations. No accepted timings or speedup ratios.

artifacts.public_projection: all67 logical cases and122 complete output arrays,137216 prepared halfwords,337920 captured halfwords,31232 payload+15616 guard words,1220 raw batches, full frozen diagnostics and three grouped traces

limitations: These three patterns do not identify a global smallest counterexample or uniquely attribute a numerical discrepancy to hardware, compiler, SDK or internal arithmetic.
Removing unrelated operands and relocating the same ordered pairs are distinct interventions; their observed outputs are not forced to match or fail.
The isolated-pattern checks separately retain the nominated output and all other255 expected-zero outputs; dense non-target outputs are not assumed zero.
Prepared inputs and three snapshots prove equality only at capture boundaries, not transient kernel inputs.
Scalar-source float operations do not establish a forced ISA sequence or prohibit contraction; unchanged kernel bodies do not establish unchanged emitted binaries.
Historical whole-buffer comparisons require matching operand contracts, not just matching dimensions; isolated patterns are excluded from dense historical comparisons.
All exact-contract failures remain failures. A passing primary pattern does not erase failed regression observations, and no tolerance or performance acceptance is introduced.
Legacy regression, prefix regression, unprofiled witness pairs and profiled pairs remain separately identified.
One C550/native software stack with bounded deterministic packed FP16 operands, initially zero accumulator and one16x16 output tile; no arbitrary-input or framework GEMM qualification.
